.. change::
    :tags: feature, environment

    Added optional staged offline artifacts.  ``alembic upgrade --sql
    --staged`` (or ``downgrade``) compiles a migration into a JSON artifact
    that splits each revision into transaction, autocommit, and version
    registration phases, with read-only checks derived from the compiled
    definitions.  The new ``alembic staged-check``, ``alembic staged-apply``,
    and ``alembic staged-sql`` commands let an external runner reconcile and
    replay an artifact without a project checkout.  Already-applied phases
    are skipped, a phase whose DDL landed but whose version was not written
    is completed when the backend is non-transactional, and conflicting
    definitions abort before any write and name the offending phase.
